description: An AI coding agent guardrail — a CLI hook that blocks destructive git and filesystem commands and secret file access before they execute. Supports Amp Code, Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, and Pi.
